page.content:
Softer, spiritually framed art Jun passed toward Jin and Asuka.

How Kazama-style traditional martial arts connects

  • Character: Jun Kazama — Jun fights in Kazama-style traditional martial arts.
  • Character: Asuka Kazama — Asuka uses the same Kazama-style art as Jun.

What is Kazama-style traditional martial arts?

Kazama-style traditional martial arts is Jun and Asuka's contrasting discipline — parries, sweeping kicks, and the hope that Jin might fight as a Kazama instead of a Mishima.

Key threads lead to Jun Kazama and Asuka Kazama.
